title: Commit: feat(l0): bind 10 function contracts to globus-os implementations (SSOT)
content:
feat(l0): bind 10 function contracts to globus-os implementations (SSOT)

Repository-stand check per the L0 Sollstruktur acceptance sequence:
which of the 35 proposed contracts have implementations today.

Result at globus-os main 3bf0001 (exact binding SHA per entry):

10 contracts MAPPED with full SSOT (repo, path, symbol, commit
SHA, blob SHA):
- ATC-L0-CPU-001/002/004 <- hal/cpu.rs CpuInfo::detect,
  vendor_name, features_from_leaves (CPUID; partial: no
  brand_string, x86-64 only, sse2 only)
- ATC-L0-MEM-001/002 <- bootloader mmap.rs MemoryMap (firmware
  regions; partial: no NUMA/ECC/type)
- ATC-L0-THM-001 <- power.rs ThermalZone, check_thermal,
  thermal_zone_count
- ATC-L0-PWR-001 <- power.rs Rsdp/Fadt/PowerManager (partial:
  no full S/C/P-state enumeration)
- ATC-L0-IO-001/003 <- hw_drivers.rs PciBus::scan,
  PCI_CLASS_NETWORK, VirtioNetDevice (partial: PCI not full
  PCIe topology; virtio backend only)
- ATC-L0-DISC-001 <- kernel main.rs boot-time inventory
  (CPU + memory map + ACPI tables)

25 contracts remain UNRESOLVED with documented evidence-based
reasons (not bare UNRESOLVED):
- GPU-001..006: gpu.rs is a PLANNED stub (blob b2184d63)
- NPU-001..005: no NPU code anywhere (earlier grep hits were
  false positives from 'input')
- SEC-001..003: IdentityKeyHal references TPM/TEE only as
  abstract key backends; no detection
- STO-001..003: block-device abstraction exists, storage
  driver is a PLANNED stub
- IO-002: no IOMMU presence query
- CPU-003/005/006, MEM-003, DISC-002/003/004: no matching
  implementations in kernel HAL

Honesty rules preserved:
- No contract upgraded to IMPLEMENTED or VERIFIED: functional
  verification at binding SHA 3bf0001 is pending (prior
  globus-os workspace suite 1298/1298 green at 2682d49f is NOT
  valid evidence for 3bf0001)
- All MAPPED entries carry verification.result=NOT_RUN with the
  open gap documented
- All UNRESOLVED entries carry evidence-based status_reason

Catalog bumped to 0.2.0. Validator: 19/19 checks pass.
